question: What was the first name of the Mughal Emperor Babur?
solution:
​The correct answer is __**Zahiruddin**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Babur (Zahiruddin Muhammad) is the founder of the Mughal Empire in India.
 
• He was a descendant of Timur (on his father’s side) and Genghis Khan (on his Mother’s side).
 
• His original name was Zahiruddin Muhammad.
 
• In 1494 at the age of 11, Babur became the ruler of Farghana (at present in Chinese Turkistan) succeeding Umar Shaikh Mirza, his father.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Babur

 
 
• He is the founder of the Mughal Empire.
 
• He fought the first Battle of Panipat in 1526 with Ibrahim Lodhi and laid the foundation of the Mughal Empire.
 
• His autobiography Tuzuk-i-Babri was written in the **Turkish **Language.
 
• In 1527 his general Mir Baki built Babri Maszid.
 
• He died in 1530.
 
 
 
• Humayun
 
 
• He was the son of Babur.
 
• He was a mathematician and astronomer.
 
• His biography Humayunama was written by his sister Gulbadan Begum.
 
 
 
• Akbar
 
 
• He was born in 1542 at Amarkot.
 
• He fought the second battle of Panipat in 1556 with Hemu and he defeated Hemu.
 
• He abolished the religious tax Jizya.
 
• He founded a new religion **"Din-i- Allahi".**
 
• His biography was written by Abul Fazal " Ain-i-Akbari".
